The plate looks like a standard 7-inch (about 18 cm) paper plate holding roughly 9 slices of what appears to be sausage, possibly a cooked smoked sausage or kielbasa. Each slice is about 4 cm across and 1.5 cm thick, so it weighs around 20 g. Nine slices come to roughly 180 g. Sausage runs about 300 kcal per 100 g, which gives about 540 kcal. Some slices are thinner, so I'm lowering the mass estimate to about 160 g, which comes to roughly 480 kcal.
